message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t provide the CNAME record IDs for `sample.com` without actually querying the VirusTotal API. However, you can retrieve them yourself by making a request to the API endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

In the JSON response, look under the `data.relationships.cnames.data` array; each element’s `id` field is the ID of a CNAME record.
